dialog.english:
Look, T.K! Ogremon's over
there.
What's he doing here?

(Gh! Why are the brats here?! I'll
have to put on a little act!)
dialog.translation:
(Argh! Qué hacen aquí
estos mocosos?! Habrá que
fingir un poco!)

dialog.english:
He's not coming to attack us like
he usually does...
dialog.translation:
No viene a atacarnos como
suele hacer...

dialog.english: Think he's planning something?

Ahem! Hey, whatcha doin' here at
the arena?
dialog.translation:
Ejem! Oye, qué hacéis
aquí en la arena?

dialog.english:
You're the Ogremon who's attacked
us before, aren't you?
dialog.translation:
Eres el Ogremon que nos
atacó antes, no?

dialog.english:
No, that'd be my cousin's
great-grandfather's little brother
Ogremon.
dialog.translation:
No, ese sería el hermano
menor del bisabuelo de mi
primo, Ogremon.

dialog.english: I'm a different Ogremon!
I'm a different Ogremon!
I'm a different Ogremon!
Well, we'll leave it at that.
What are you doing here, Ogremon?

My favorite bone club's gotten all
banged up, so I'm here to get a
new one.
dialog.translation:
Mi garrote favorito quedó
hecho pedazos, y vengo a
por uno nuevo.

dialog.english: What kind of bone do you need?

How couldja not know? Believe it
or not, it's a SkullGreymon bone!
dialog.translation:
Cómo que no sabéis? Aunque
no lo creáis, un hueso de
SkullGreymon!

dialog.english: A SkullGreymon bone?!

Oh hey! Yeah...you guys, why
don'tcha help me out?
dialog.translation:
Ah, oye! Sí... por qué no
me echáis una mano?

dialog.english:
I'm goin' to the back of the
underground ruins. Follow me!
dialog.translation:
Voy al fondo de las ruinas
subterráneas. Seguidme!

dialog.english:
We'll have to help Ogremon, we
can't back out of it like this...
dialog.translation:
Tendremos que ayudar a
Ogremon, no podemos echarnos
atrás ahora...

dialog.english:
Hey, guys... is it okay to trust
that Ogremon?
dialog.translation:
Oye, chicos... podemos
confiar en ese Ogremon?

dialog.english: We'll beat him up!
Doesn't feel like a trap.

Once we get a chance, I'll have
Garurumon take him out.
dialog.translation:
En cuanto pueda, haré que
Garurumon lo elimine.

dialog.english:
That's not what I meant, I mean
whether he's trying to lead us
into a trap!
dialog.translation:
No es eso lo que quería
decir, sino si intenta
llevarnos a una trampa!

dialog.english:
Aren't you thinking too far into
this?
dialog.translation:
No le estás dando demasiadas
vueltas?

dialog.english: Ugh, I don't care anymore!

Doesn't feel like he's leading us
into a trap.
dialog.translation:
No parece que nos lleve
a una trampa.

dialog.english:
After all, we're the ones who
caught him off guard.
dialog.translation:
Al fin y al cabo, lo
pillamos desprevenido.

dialog.english:
What if we're being naive? What if
he ends up holding me hostage!
dialog.translation:
Y si somos unos ingenuos?
Y si acabo de rehén!

dialog.english: Then I'll come save you.

If you're willing to do that, then
I'll forgive you!
dialog.translation:
Si estás dispuesto a eso,
te perdono!

dialog.english:
You're finally here! Let's start
huntin' for that bone.
dialog.translation:
Por fin llegáis! Vamos a
buscar ese hueso.

dialog.english: So now we're bone hunters?

Shut up! What I'm sayin' is, we
need to hunt down a SkullGreymon
bone!
dialog.translation:
Cállate! Lo que digo es que
hay que cazar un hueso de
SkullGreymon!

dialog.english:
SkullGreymon's hard to deal with,
so do exactly as I say!
dialog.translation:
SkullGreymon es difícil,
así que haced justo lo
que digo!

dialog.english: That's a huge door...
I wonder what's behind it?
Wanna take a look?
Yeah!
Hey, little helper! Whatcha doin'?
Aaaaaaaaaaaaah!
It's SkullGreymon!
T.K!

Stop! A SkullGreymon that's just
been revived is unstoppable!
dialog.translation:
Parad! Un SkullGreymon
recién revivido es
imparable!

dialog.english:
T.K's my little brother! I
can't just abandon him and run
away!
dialog.translation:
T.K es mi hermano pequeño!
No puedo abandonarlo y
huir sin más!

dialog.english: Tch! Fine, then!
Matt!
T.K, you're okay!
Yeah!
Good thing Patamon's fine, too.
Ah, that was a shock...

Ogremon, did you find a bone you
could use?
dialog.translation:
Ogremon, encontraste un
hueso que sirviera?

dialog.english:
Yeah! I've finally nabbed a good
bone! Matt!
dialog.translation:
Sí! Por fin pillé un buen
hueso! Matt!

dialog.english: What do you want, Ogremon!

I've fought a lot of battles, but
to stand up against the fearsome
SkullGreymon!
dialog.translation:
He luchado en muchas
batallas, pero plantarle cara
al temible SkullGreymon!

dialog.english:
You're pretty okay guys! You've
got guts! I'll give you this!
Thanks for helping with the hunt!
dialog.translation:
Sois buena gente! Tenéis
agallas! Toma, esto es para
ti! Gracias por la caza!

dialog.english: Hey, wait a minute...
Should we take it?
Thanks, Matt!

Of course! You're my brother,
after all.
dialog.translation:
Claro! Al fin y al cabo,
eres mi hermano.
